name: PS5: Wake → Guide loader → kstuff → ShadowMount → zftpd
description: From rest mode: wake the console over Remote Play, open the configured guide loader, wait for port 9021, send kstuff, ShadowMountPlus and zftpd, then verify FTP.
notes: PS5 only, and the console has to be paired on the Remote Play tab: waking it uses that pairing. Configure the User Guide host and calibrate both guide scripts for its prompts and selected action first. This template carries no automatic trigger, so it takes the controller only when you run it; use "PS5: Guide loader → kstuff → ShadowMount → zftpd" for the watcher that reacts to a loader going down on a console that is already on. A failed port check reruns the guide steps at most twice, then reports failure; it never reports success merely because the button script completed.

steps.name: Wake the console over Remote Play
Wait for the console to finish waking
Wait for ELF loader; retry guide at most twice

author: P5 Manager
